           <quote source="db:3772" n="2.204cd"> <lg><l>gang gi rang [(p.258)] bzhin 'gyur med pa ||</l>
            <l>de la mkhas rnams rtag ces brjod ||</l></lg></quote> 
         ces pa'i tshul gyis rtag pa zhes bya ba ni rang bzhin gcig dus du ma dang 'brel ba yin la rim dang cig car gyis don byed pa du ma la rtog pa'i rtog stangs gnyis rang rig gis nang du 'gal bar nyams su myong tsa na yul de gnyis mi 'gal snyam pa'i dogs pa chod la | de nyid rtag pa'i steng du rim dang cig car gyis don byed pas stong pa'i phyogs chos mngon sum gyis grub pa yin no zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
